static_traits.name: Zhao Meilin
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, family information Not provided
static_traits.social_status: Tense relationships with colleagues, often seeking reassurance from others; though having friends and family to talk to, has not yet shared feelings of inadequacy with them
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;not yet received psychotherapy;not yet experienced similar problems
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe experiences concretely; tending toward catastrophizing and self-labeling; self-Reflection ability fair; willingness to seek help present but difficulty expressing to family and friends; speech rate Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: I feel half of my Students fail, which makes me believe I am a terrible teacher.
basic_info.core_demands: I want to feel better and be more confident in my teaching.

special_situations.event: At the start of the school year when seeing midterm grades, discovering many Students fail
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If many Students fail, it shows I am a terrible teacher
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Change teaching methods and provide extra support for Students
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Half of the Students fail, I must be a terrible teacher

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I must ensure all Students succeed, otherwise I am just a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keep Self-monitoring and work overtime grading, tutoring
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These poor grades prove I am not competent

special_situations.event: Thinking about upcoming exams or the release of grades
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If Students keep failing, my career will be ruined
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Worries in advance, repeatedly rehearses stricter teaching plans
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will keep failing; my work will get worse

special_situations.event: When interacting with colleagues and seeking comfort
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If colleagues have not explicitly affirmed me, it shows they think I am not capable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly seek reassurance and feedback from colleagues
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must think I am incompetent

core_conflict.wish: Longs for recognition and affirmation; to prove self a competent teacher
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being judged as incompetent, being negated, worrying about failing Students
defense_goal: Avoids revealing to relatives and friends to avoid being judged or shamed

object_relations.self_representation: An incompetent teacher needing affirmation from others
A caretaker bearing full responsibility for Student failure

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When directly asked about teaching effectiveness or invited to look back at success evidence and challenge the belief 'I am a bad teacher'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously understand Questioning as criticism or negate (like being judged by colleagues)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use self-blaming language (such as 'It is all my fault' 'I am too bad'), low tone, admitting fault but ignoring external factors and situational complexity.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether feelings were shared with relatives and friends, or invited to express vulnerable experiences
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worries that after expressing, one will be judged or become a burden to others
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Respond briefly, avoid emotional details, restrained tone, quickly Displace to Work or task topics.

manifestations: Not yet shared feelings of inadequacy with friends and family
Distant colleague relationships, often needing comfort

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent Self-denial and self-blame in conversations
Highly concerned about others' evaluations, attributing poor grades entirely to oneself

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Assuming colleagues think one is not competent
Presumes in interactions that others will view her negatively

exception_events.target_problem: When grading homework or seeing failures, the visitor usually attributes failure entirely to oneself and develops the catastrophic thought 'I am a terrible teacher', followed by Anxiety worsened, Sleep affected.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In moments when some Students thank her for her support and high-performing Students succeed, she notices her positive impact and receives positive feedback, which buffers somewhat compared to the usual sense of 'total failure'.
exception_events.reason: Different evidence and support: Students' thanks and success provided external affirmation, letting her briefly see her own contribution.

positive_force: Responsible toward Students, proactively changing teaching methods and providing extra support
Willing to seek help and start counseling
Able to recognize external factors affecting Student grades (family/personal problems)
Able to recall being thanked by Students and success cases
Proposes the idea of recording positive feedback and setting realistic goals
negative_force: Catastrophizing, overgeneralization, mental filtering, mind reading and predicting the not yet future and other cognitive distortions are prominent
Excessive personalization, attributing Student failure entirely to oneself
Continuously seeking external reassurance leads to Tense relationships with colleagues
Not expressing inner feelings to family and friends, social support not yet effectively utilized, Increased sense of isolation
Decreased self-esteem, Anxiety and Sleep disturbance, reducing Work motivation and performance

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophizing self-label: 'I am a terrible teacher'
antecedent: Seeing many failures in midterm grades
Thinking about upcoming exams or the release of grades
target_behavior.core_reason: Using Student grades as the sole criterion for evaluating one's own ability, bearing the pressure of 'must ensure Student success', cognitive distortions appearing (catastrophizing, overgeneralization, personalization)
target_behavior.function: Seeking control and self-punishment, driving excessive effort to avoid failure
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety worsened, Decreased self-esteem, Sleep disturbed, Work motivation and performance impaired

target_behavior.behavior: Frequently seeking comfort and recognition from colleagues
antecedent: Discussing teaching or grades with colleagues
target_behavior.core_reason: Self-worth depends on others' evaluations, worrying about being criticized or negated
target_behavior.function: Gaining external validation and emotional soothing
target_behavior.consequence: Tense relationships with colleagues, dependence on reassurance instead intensifies the sense of Self-denial

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids expressing inner distress to family and friends
antecedent: At the thought of talking about inadequacy with friends or family
target_behavior.core_reason: Hard to speak up and express vulnerability, worried about being judged or adding to others' burden
target_behavior.function: Avoids exposing vulnerability and potential embarrassment
target_behavior.consequence: Insufficient Social support, sense of Loneliness and stress persist, difficulty relaxing
